#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->

This makes sure `OptionMarginModel` respects the following:
- Long options are paid 100% upfront, their initial margin requirement is their premium.
- Long option do not have maintenance margin requirements.
- Short options margin do not include premium since it is being credited.

There are some screenshots from IB in #7291 with references to maintenance and initial margin requirements for options.

Long naked call (selling a call without having the stock) IB reference:
![image](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/assets/25215064/d58041bd-3352-456c-8213-e734a0296ca9)

Short naked call (buying a call without having the stock) IB reference:
![image](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/assets/25215064/ae86dfcb-30de-4ea1-a53a-0a12bf12fc5a)

Long naked put (selling a put without having the stock) IB reference:
![image](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/assets/25215064/58769c47-277c-4dec-8f81-05499dbc39da)

Short naked put (buying a put without having the stock) IB reference:
![image](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/assets/25215064/163e95ef-36f0-43ad-9195-9b3fd9f38cd8)

issue_context.title: Premium in options margin requirements
issue_context.body: #### Expected Behavior In IB, long options do not have margin requirements, neither initial nor maintenance. In Lean, since we account for the option premium, intial margin requirement for long options should include the premium. On the other hand, short options should not include premium since it is credited to the user. Call and put option margin reference from IB: #### Actual Behavior Lean includes options premium both for short/long options initial and maintenance margin. #### Potential Solution Review `OptionMarginModel` margin calculation methods and make sure the premium is only added for long options. #### Reproducing the Problem Reference code: ```csharp var equity = CreateEquity(); equity.SetMarketPrice(new Tick { Value = 425m }); var callOption = CreateOption(Symbols.CreateOptionSymbol("SPY", OptionRight.Call, 300, new DateTime(2023, 08, 23))); callOption.SetMarketPrice(new Tick { Value = 124m }); callOption.Underlying = equity; callOption.Holdings.SetHoldings(124m, 1); var putOption = CreateOption(Symbols.CreateOptionSymbol("SPY", OptionRight.Put, 300, new DateTime(2023, 08, 23))); putOption.SetMarketPrice(new Tick { Value = 0.43m }); putOption.Underlying = equity; putOption.Holdings.SetHoldings(0.43m, 1); var buyingPowerModel = new OptionMarginModel(); Log.Debug($"Long call initial margin: {buyingPowerModel.GetInitialMarginRequirement(new InitialMarginParameters(callOption, 1m)).Value}"); Log.Debug($"Short call initial margin: {buyingPowerModel.GetInitialMarginRequirement(new InitialMarginParameters(callOption, -1m)).Value}"); Log.Debug($"Long call maintenance margin: {buyingPowerModel.GetInitialMarginRequirement(new InitialMarginParameters(callOption, 1m)).Value}"); Log.Debug($"Short call maintenance margin: {buyingPowerModel.GetInitialMarginRequirement(new InitialMarginParameters(callOption, -1m)).Value}"); Log.Debug($"Long put initial margin: {buyingPowerModel.GetMaintenanceMargin(MaintenanceMarginParameters.ForQuantityAtCurrentPrice(putOption, 1m)).Value}"); Log.Debug($"Short put initial margin: {buyingPowerModel.GetMaintenanceMargin(MaintenanceMarginParameters.ForQuantityAtCurrentPrice(putOption, -1m)).Value}"); Log.Debug($"Long put maintenance margin: {buyingPowerModel.GetMaintenanceMargin(MaintenanceMarginParameters.ForQuantityAtCurrentPrice(putOption, 1m)).Value}"); Log.Debug($"Short put maintenance margin: {buyingPowerModel.GetMaintenanceMargin(MaintenanceMarginParameters.ForQuantityAtCurrentPrice(putOption, -1m)).Value}"); ``` Output: ``` Long call initial margin: 12400 Short call initial margin: -20899.999999999999999999999999 Long call maintenance margin: 12400 Short call maintenance margin: -20899.999999999999999999999999 Long put initial margin: 43.00 Short put initial margin: 3043.0000000000000000000000000 Long put maintenance margin: 43.00 Short put maintenance margin: 3043.0000000000000000000000000 ``` #### System Information Windows 11 #### Checklist - [x] I have completely filled out this template - [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch - [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues) - [x] I have provided detailed steps to reproduce the issue
